note: The variants of variants.json that read wrong by their source review at the gi3 scope repair, each pinned by its input (the variant) and its exact output, with the reason. A row that comes to read right fails ScopeCorpusTests and is removed here deliberately; a new wrong row is a regression.

wrong: today's visit not read: routing office E/M = None
asks whether the visit was performed
A21-ev-plan.reason: A note with no marker of today's visit (interpretation 44: such notes stay held, a known limit): no title, heading, visit statement, MDM or time names the visit - only 'Patient status: established', 'Site: office, POS 11' and history, examination, assessment and plan sections - so routing reads no office visit and the E/M code is held with a performed_status question, never excluded and never ready. Its hold no longer presents the plan's follow-up as doubt about today's visit.

wrong: today's visit not read: routing office E/M = None
asks whether the visit was performed
A21-ev-typ.reason: As A21-ev-plan, with Corti's typical citations: no marker of today's visit, so the E/M code is held with a performed_status question (interpretation 44), never excluded.

wrong: today's visit not read: routing office E/M = None
asks whether the visit was performed
W04-ev-plan.reason: A Word-table note with no marker of today's visit (interpretation 44, a known limit): its rows name the date, the place of service and 'Established patient', and its sections the history, examination, assessment and plan, but nothing names the visit, so the E/M code is held with a performed_status question, never excluded and never ready. The table-row date is asked by design (context's form-date rule).

wrong: office E/M read as performed today
P02-ev-row.reason: A planned-only document read as a visit (known limit RC6, as at the installed revision): the appointment reminder's row 'Visit type | Established patient office visit' has no planning word in its own clause, so routing reads that visit statement performed; the appointment date is in another row. The E/M code is held by its basis and date questions, never ready.

wrong: office E/M read as performed today
P05-ev-plan.reason: A planned-only document read as a visit (known limit RC6, as at the installed revision): the referral letter's 'for a new patient consultation' is a visit statement with no planning word in its own clause, read performed. The E/M code is held by its setting, basis and date questions, never ready.

wrong: office E/M read as performed though the note says the visit is in the future
P07-ev-title.reason: A pre-charted note read as a visit by its title (known limit, new with the visit title marker): 'Clinic note - return visit' in the head is a visit title naming no other occurrence, and 'Note started in advance of the visit; to be completed on the day.' names no occurrence word, so the title reads as today's visit on its stated 'Visit date: 2026-11-18'. By the source the visit may not have happened. The E/M code is held by its setting, status and basis questions, never ready.

C06-ev-plan.reason: The extent and inventory lens's (RC7), not this one's: the office flexible sigmoidoscopy is documented only by its instrument ('The flexible sigmoidoscope was advanced to 40 cm ... biopsies'), which names no routed mention, so the planned repeat decides routing's family status ('planned'). The inventory reads the sigmoidoscopy performed and 45331 is ready; only routing's family status is wrong.

wrong: office E/M read as performed today
F02-ev-time.reason: A procedure's time read as E/M time (known limit, as at the installed revision): 'Total physician time for the procedure: 25 minutes.' matches the total-time wording and names no word of NOT_EM_TIME, so an EGD report reads an office E/M performed with a time basis. Held by its setting, status and separate-E/M questions, never ready.

wrong: office E/M read as performed today
F08-ev-time.reason: A framed clinician time on a procedure day read as E/M time (known limit, new with the clinician-time subjects; the class of F09): 'Physician time on the date of service: 35 minutes, including the procedure ...' is framed by 'on the date of service' and names no word of NOT_EM_TIME, so an EGD report reads an office E/M performed with a time basis. A time that includes the procedure is not the visit's (AMA E/M time excludes separately reported services); refusing it is a later NOT_EM_TIME repair. Held by its setting, status and separate-E/M questions, never ready.

wrong: office E/M read as performed today
F09-ev-time.reason: A procedure day's total time read as E/M time (known limit, as at the installed revision; F08's control): 'Total time on the date of service: 35 minutes, including the procedure ...' is the total-time wording with no word of NOT_EM_TIME. Held by its setting, status and separate-E/M questions, never ready.
